rootCauses: Body proxy handle tip was used as the weapon anchor, concatenating two visible handle lengths.
Some weapon rotations disagreed with the held proxy shaft; the 30-degree downward contact workaround created a visible kink.
Weapon was composited over the gloves without foreground finger occlusion.
fixes: Register all 44 frames at the leading fist and measured rigid shaft angle.
Use original weapon attachment (195,96), giving 9.59 packed pixels to the beginning of the guard; do not redraw or stretch any weapon section.
Composite unchanged body, rigid original weapon, then original glove pixels from recorded hand masks.

For nearly level cuts against a short target, approach the near side of its ground tile and align the middle of the blade; feet/shadow/depth sort share that ground anchor. No body/view vertical offset is added.
